desc:
• SOURCE OF CALCIUM: REESE'S Puffs cereal treat bars have a good source of calcium

  • MADE WITH REAL PEANUT BUTTER: You don't always need a bowl to crunch into the taste of REESE'S Puff's cereal; Made with real REESE'S peanut butter, chocolate flavor, and delicious cereal pieces

  • LUNCH BOX FAVORITE: Add to the pantry, pack in a lunch box, and keep on hand for snack time; These single serve bars make tasty, on the go after school snacks

  • PERFECTLY PORTABLE: Take the delicious cereal crunch and flavor of these snacks with you anywhere; Individually wrapped bars are easy for car rides, after class activities, and anytime sweet cravings pop up

  • CONTAINS: One big cardboard box of REESE'S Puffs Treat Bars, Peanut Butter and Cocoa, Snack Bars, Value Pack, 16 Ct, 13.6 oz; Perfect for instant snacking
features:
Features

Classic Reese’s Flavor
A mix of real peanut butter and rich cocoa in every bite.

Made with Whole Grain
Whole grain corn is the first ingredient, providing about 15 grams per serving.

Fortified with 12 Essential Vitamins & Minerals
Includes calcium, vitamin D, iron, B vitamins, and zinc to support daily nutrition.

No Artificial Flavors or Colors
Reformulated to be free from artificial ingredients for a more natural choice.

Kid-Approved Taste
Loved by families for its crunchy texture and sweet, nutty flavor.

Benefits

Delicious & Nostalgic
Tastes like your favorite candy in cereal form — perfect for a sweet start to the day or an anytime treat.

Supports Whole Grain Intake
Each serving helps meet daily whole grain recommendations in a tasty way.

Nutrient-Boosted Breakfast
Helps support daily needs with added calcium, iron, vitamin D, and other key nutrients.

Versatile Snacking Option
Great with milk, dry as a snack, in lunchboxes, or as a topping for yogurt or desserts.

Quick & Convenient
Ready in seconds — just add milk or enjoy it straight from the box.
ingredients: Cereal (whole grain corn, sugar, REESE'S peanut butter [peanuts, sugar, monoglycerides, peanut oil, salt, molasses, corn starch], dextrose, corn meal, corn syrup, canola and/or sunflower oil, salt, HERSHEY'S cocoa, caramel color, trisodium phosphate, natural and artificial flavor. Vitamin E [mixed tocopherols] added to preserve freshness. Vitamins and minerals: tricalcium phosphate, calcium carbonate, vitamin C [sodium ascorbate], iron and zinc [mineral nutrients], a B vitamin [niacinamide], vitamin B6 [pyridoxine hydrochloride], vitamin B1 [thiamin mononitrate], vitamin A [palmitate], vitamin B2 [riboflavin], a B vitamin [folic acid], vitamin B12, vitamin D3), Corn Syrup, Chocolate Flavored Crisp Rice (rice flour, cocoa processed with alkali, sugar, malt extract, salt, caramel color), Sugar, Mini REESE'S Peanut Butter Chips (partially defatted peanuts, sugar, hydrogenated vegetable oil [palm kernel, soybean], corn syrup solids, dextrose, reduced protein whey, salt, palm kernel oil, artificial flavor, soy lecithin), Vegetable Oil (palm kernel, palm and/or canola), Peanut Flour, High Fructose Corn Syrup, Fructose, Vegetable Glycerin, REESE'S Peanut Butter (peanuts, sugar, monoglycerides, peanut oil, salt, molasses, corn starch). Contains 2% or less of: Peanuts, Calcium Carbonate, Sorbitol, Salt, Nonfat Dry Milk, Corn Starch, Peanut Oil, Natural And Artificial Flavor, Gelatin, Soy Lecithin.
